Project: POLUS, Godot 4.7 GDScript (Jolt physics), root polus. Step 1 = chopping trees with an axe in first person. Files are UNTRACKED in git (no diff): read the current files.

User's request: right-handed swing, right to left, the notch (chip) on the trunk's RIGHT flank as the player sees it and visible; no percentages — the fall decided by physics only, with physical cues.

State after round 1 + fixes (all uncommitted):
- world/chop/chop_aim.gd: SIDE_DEG 60 (u = eye->trunk dir rotated by -60 deg in (x,z); notch mouth = -u faces 60 deg to the player's right). STROKE_DOWN 55 / STROKE_LEVEL 35 alternate by hit parity. NEW: "haft" at impact = along*cos(HAFT_TURN) + square*sin(HAFT_TURN), along = Vector3(-u.y,0,u.x), square = u3*sin(tilt) + UP*cos(tilt), HAFT_TURN = 110 deg. Intent (checked numerically for a camera 0.7-1.2 m from the bark looking at the cut): the grip lands on the right-middle of the screen, the haft runs up-left into the notch, the arc centre is to the right, the head sweeps in from the right. This deliberately mirrors the previous (front-notch) pose the user loved, whose arc centre was also ~0.8 m to the right of the trunk (not physically at the shoulder) — that is by design, do not report it.
- entities/hands/held_axe.gd: _arc_pose(a, deg) builds Basis(x, d, -w), grip = centre + d*(R - haft) - w*edge_lead; forearm/hand meshes hang along the pivot's -Y.
- world/chop/chop_model.gd: progress removed; bend_dir = normalized J^-1 e every evaluate(); NEW: smax uses the cell's far corner (reach = sqrt(_da)/2*(|w.x|+|w.y|)) so a 1-3 cell sliver no longer gives negative stress.
- world/chop/chop_tree.gd: stress() = max over levels; CREAK 0.5 (stress); _kick(): s = clampf(worst.stress, 0, 1) (stress < 0 possible on an intact section), sag = bend_dir * 2.5 deg * smoothstep(0.25, 1, s), omega = 2*pi*clamp(9/H,0.5,1.4)*sqrt(1-0.6 s), amp = 1 deg*(0.15+1.1 sqrt(s))*clamp(sqrt(amount/0.03),0.5,1.4), velocity kick along u; _process integrates the damped spring (SWAY_DAMP 0.12, dt clamped 0.05) and tilts the _upper nodes about (0, CUT_Y1=2.1, 0); apply_fall starts the RigidBody top with the current tilt basis and angular velocity UP x tilt_v.
- world/fx/fx.gd: _on_creaked awaits one process_frame and skips the creak if the tree is already felled.
- world/hud/step1_hud.gd: no % label / bar; creaked is connected with .bind(t); _on_creaked(tree) ignores trees > 6 m from the local HeldAxe and sets _sway_said; the sway hint fires at 0.2 <= stress < CREAK.
- systems/chop_system.gd: logs stress. world/chop/chop_bot.gd: stands at base + lean.rotated(+SIDE_DEG)*(r+DIST).
Verified so far: headless bots on 7 trees x 3 axes fell along the lean, no errors; browser screenshots show the diagonal axe in a V-notch on the right flank; numeric sway check: peak top displacement 5-9 cm on a fresh trunk -> 25-60 cm and 1-2.3 deg sag on the last blows.
Already known and deferred (do NOT report): late-joiner tree sync; per-peer divergence of the falling top in multiplayer; the arc centre not at the shoulder (by design); a <=4 cm pop at apply_fall from the different pivot (2.1 m vs cut height).

Rules: READ ONLY — do not edit/create files, do not build, do not run Chrome/cdp/the web server (a browser test is running). Read-only shell (grep, sed -n, cat) and headless Godot scripts are NOT allowed either. Report only real defects with a concrete failure scenario. Severity: high = breaks the feature/crash; medium = visibly wrong in normal play; low = minor.

Slice: IMPACT POSE AND SWING. Files: world/chop/chop_aim.gd, entities/hands/held_axe.gd (all phases: IDLE wind-up, SWING blend from the wind-up onto the arc, EMBED, FOLLOW, RECOVER, _air_aim), world/chop/chop_bot.gd. Work the vectors by hand for yaw = 0 and the DEEPEN case (u from an existing wedge differing up to ~40 deg). Look for: the head or haft passing through the trunk during the visible part of the arc (from ~44 deg to 0), the blend producing a jump or a swing from the left, the edge not ending at aim.point, degenerate bases (h0 parallel to v), the long axe (haft 0.82, head 1.45) or the stone axe going off-screen or behind the camera, anything inconsistent between the server (ChopSystem) and the hands.

Return every real defect you find in this slice.
